notes.title: Builders of Greece Now in Full Release!🏛️⚒️
notes.content:
[h2]Rule👑Build ⚒️Thrive🌿[/h2]

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273100/Builders_of_Greece/][b]Builders of Greece[/b][/url] is now in Full Release with a Major Update🔥[/h3]

[previewyoutube=W_fSaZQGj7M;full][/previewyoutube]

We're absolutely thrilled to share some fantastic news with our amazing Builders of Greece community. After a few months of hard work, dedication, and feedback from our incredible players, [b]Builders of Greece is officially graduating from Early Access[/b]! 🚀



All those who still haven't bought Builders of Greece, now you can get it as a full game with a [b]50% launch discount[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273100/Builders_of_Greece/


[h3][b]What's New?[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Building over time
[*] New scenario
[*] New map
[*] Decree system
[*] Economy panel
[*] Trade system
[*] Quick view of the most important building information
[*] Other gods - Demeter, Hephaestus, Hades, Ares
[*] New buildings
[*] More building animations
[*] Lots of balance changes, fixes, QoL and general improvement of the game quality
[*] More citizens on the city streets
[/list]

[h3][b]Thank You, Builder![/b][/h3]
We want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who participated in the Early Access phase. Your passion, bug reports, and creative ideas have been invaluable in shaping Builders of Greece into the game it is today. We couldn't have done it without you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/dff598d16e7a6fd21e9139c26576ae02be420b57.png[/img]

[h3][b]What's Next?[/b][/h3]
The journey doesn't end here! We're committed to continually supporting Builders of Greece with regular updates, bug fixes, and possibly even more exciting content based on your ongoing feedback.

Thank you for joining us on this building adventure.

Lead your people 👥, craft your legacy 📜, and shape history 🏺!


⚒️Happy building⚒️
Builders of Greece Development Team🏗️

notes.title: Daily Deal and New Patch are HERE! 🤩
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Mighty Builders 🏛🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Today, our messengers bring you not one, but [b]two great news regarding your flourishing empire.[/b] The first one will certainly be of interest to new rulers who have not yet tried their hand at leading an ancient city, while the second one will for sure please all those who already know the hardships of ruling.

Let's start with [b]the first one[/b], shall we?


[h2]Take advantage of a unique -40% discount 👀[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/8071987436750b26e350e5133efa9de74f3c0c99.png[/img]

[b]From this very moment until August 8[/b] you can start your amazing ancient adventure with a -4️⃣0️⃣% discount. This is a perfect occasion to sit on the throne of your own settlement, which over time will evolve into a huge metropolis. See for yourself how [b]satisfying, enjoyable and challenging[/b] it is to exercise such great power! 

Spread the word among your fellow rulers and be sure to let them know that [b]-40% discount[/b] has just kicked off. The ancient world offers a place for anyone eager to lead their own city!


[h2]The new Patch 0.9.0 and its awesome features 🛠️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
On the occasion of the Daily Deal, we also decided to [b]make happy[/b] those who already own their copy of Builders of Greece. And what makes you happier than [b]a nice surprise?[/b] 😁

Based on your feedback and suggestions, as well as our own observations, we managed to implement several important features that [b]we know you've been waiting for[/b]. Those of you who remember our Content RoadMap will surely notice that some of them coincide with the changes we planned for [b]the "Great People" Milestone[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/d4cd093944fa056f76876e3160bb3e8843e6330c.gif[/img]

That being said, you can treat today's Patch as a [b]prelude to this significant phase[/b] 🤓 Of course, the "Great People" Milestone will still receive previously planned extensions such as iconic figures of the ancient world, new events, new economic panel and new maps.

[b]Ok, with that behind us, let's cut to the chase! [/b]


[h3]Check out the new Patch 0.9.0 Notes:[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
• Added an option to relocate existing buildings
• Improvements to the decoration system:
- decorations now affect the happiness of your citizens
- decorations can now be placed freely and are not affected by the building grid system
• New Sandbox map 
• Resolving a number of bugs and issues reported by the community
• Number of QoL changes:
- improvements to the warehouse and storage system
- locating buildings placed in the city via right-clicking them in the building panel


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/7984b915c5c2391bb1921e2305c9705fc3b2d240.gif[/img]

We can't wait to see your [b]renovated, rearranged and beautifully decorated cities![/b] 😍 We hope that the changes introduced will make the gameplay even more fun and engaging. As always, [b]we await your feedback[/b] on our Discord server and Social Media channels.

notes.title: The latest Patch - Blessing of Olympus - is now LIVE ⚡
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Builders 🏛🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
If you've seen our new [b]Early Access Content RoadMap[/b], you probably know that today, Builders of Greece will welcome some very special guests. Some of them are kind and caring, others do not shy away from violence... and all of them, without exception, are [b]extremely powerful![/b]

Without them, the culture and development of [b]Ancient Greece would not have been the same[/b]. And it's not just about wonderful temples, altars, or the godsfearing everyday life of all social classes 🙏 Shared beliefs helped cement communities, making it easier for them to work together and [b]pursue common goals.[/b] You and your subjects must also stand before the Gods to gain their favor... or ignite their wrath. [b]And so - let's welcome them to your Polis![/b]


[h2]It's time to meet your Patrons 🤓[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
All of the Gods will gladly accept your prayers and appreciation. However, to effectively demonstrate your devotion, [b]you must first prepare an appropriate place.[/b] Religious buildings are perfect for this purpose, the first of which is the Altar. Once the [b]Altar[/b] or other building of this kind finds its place in your city, you will gain access to the new panel shown below 👇

[i](Click to expand)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/6cb4872876c6c94fd2d777dc354612c8900e966c.png[/img]

In the Faith panel, you can see the [b]satisfaction of individual Gods[/b] and learn how they can help you with their favors. Each of the religious buildings can be dedicated to one of the Patrons, and it is up to you to forge your own mortals-to-Gods strategy! 

Will your Polis become a [b]place of worship[/b], or will you satisfy them with the[b] bare minimum?[/b] Will you commit to one particular God, or will you try to be on good terms with them all? 🤔 [b]The decision is yours alone[/b], and each choice will have its consequences... To make your task easier, we have prepared a short cheat sheet!

[h3]Each God excels in a specific area[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
🏹 [b]Artemis[/b] - Goddess of hunt, wild nature, moon and animals - thanks to her support, your ranged units will be more efficient in battle, and your Hunter's Hut will produce more meat

💕 [b]Aphrodite[/b] - Goddess of love, beauty and desire - with her help, your population will grow and reproduce faster, providing you with a stable influx of new subjects

🍇 [b]Dionysus[/b] - God of wine, theater and ecstasy - through his passion for celebration, he will help you prepare important rituals that other Gods will surely appreciate

🔥 [b]Hephaestus[/b] - God of fire and craftsmanship - thanks to his divine endurance and strength, Hephaestus improves the combat potential of your infantry units

😇 [b]Hestia[/b] - Goddess of family, travelers and newborns - her kindness and caring nature strengthens the bonds between the inhabitants of your city and allows more of them to fit under the roof of one house


[h2]Rituals and the fury of the Gods ⚡[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/7bd7add01b9b4ac5f97c72297e246911368639b3.gif[/img]

The most effective way to win a God's favor is by [b]performing special rituals[/b] in a dedicated place of worship. Preparing such rituals is often time-consuming and can be expensive, as the appropriate goods are needed to carry them out. Nevertheless, as you already know, [b]it is a profitable investment.[/b] Especially since ignoring the jealous Ancient Gods is not a good idea...

[h3]The Gods can show their displeasure in various ways - and none of them are good for your city! 😱 Angry Patrons may, for example:[/h3]

• scare animals away from your hunting grounds
• cause a plague of infertility
• spark off the degradation of tools and valuable items
• turn other divine beings against your Polis
• cause random houses to fall into ruin... 

And unfortunately, there may be more such negative effects! ☠️ With that in mind, be sure to carefully [b]plan your relationships with the inhabitants of Olympus[/b].


[h2]Improvements to the Technology system 📜[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
While the introduction of the Faith system is the biggest change in today's Patch, [b]it is not the only one.[/b] Based on your feedback, we also decided to make a number of changes to another very important feature of the game, namely the [b]Technology system. [/b]

An overhaul of the Technology system is aimed at increasing its influence on the game throughout its course 🧐 This means that your [b]development decisions will now have an even greater impact[/b] on how your entire Polis performs. [b]Moreover[/b], from now on you have the possibility to choose the development path that [b]best suits you[/b], which was not so strongly emphasized before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/f5d2cb0443434c2b834469309a84a6eb32960793.gif[/img]

More specifically, the Technology system has been divided into two kinds of perks: [b]basic and elite[/b] ⭐ The first of them is necessary to push your city forward, while the latter will show their full potential in the mid and late game. [b]Thanks to precisely adjusted gradation[/b], elite perks will affect areas such as various production modifiers or the improvement of combat units.


[h2]New Maps 🗺️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Many of you, eager for new challenges, asked about new maps. We have done our best to fulfill this request, and so... we're happy to announce that with today's update, [b]two new unexplored lands have appeared in Sandbox mode[/b]! And this is by no means the end - we will soon present you with even more maps, both in Scenario and Sandbox modes. [b]Explorers, rejoice![/b] 😁

[b]• Olympus Island[/b] - land of plateaus and plains, with a few gentle descents to the blue sea. A perfect place to build a vast, powerful Polis stretching to the horizon. If you dream of a city built at different heights, this place is just perfect.

[b]• Hera Island[/b] - this unique island boasts a long, straight shoreline that can be used for maritime trade and fishing. Inland stretches a vast plain, the edges of which are marked by high, inaccessible yet majestic mountains.

Thank you for your time, Builders! We wish you many new awesome adventures in the mystical world of Ancient Greece. [b]May the Gods bless you all! [/b]🙏

[h3]And what better way to picture them than... in a form of a Content RoadMap?[/h3]

Thanks to the RoadMap below, you will find out exactly what features and mechanics will appear in the [b]next phases of the Builders of Greece project development[/b] and check how your ancient empires will change in the near future. We know this is something you've been waiting for, so we'll let RoadMap speak for itself!

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43072654/3bc3c4be4d75be743545cd273d72e54aef792e41.png[/img]

[h3]As you can see, we've divided the project development path into five stages:[/h3]

Blessing of Olympus 🙏, Great People 🧐, Age of War ⚔️, Birth of Democracy ☝️, and Golden Era 🏛, each with their own set of interesting features to offer! 

[b]There's something for everyone among them[/b] - builders will be delighted with the new non-instant building system and the ability to relocate structures, fans of glorious battles will have the opportunity to try out the overhauled combat system, there is also something for those who wanted to worship the Gods or rulers who can't wait to start their new settlement on whole new maps 🌐 

Not to mention new management options, random events, helpful panels and... [b]many, many more cool additions![/b]

Fortunately, you won't have to wait long for the first phase, called [b]"Blessing of Olympus"[/b], to arrive. Will they be your allies or your foes? [b]Time will tell...[/b]

notes.title: Builders of Greece EA - Coming on 27 Feb 2024
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Builders! 🏛️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
This is the news we've all been waiting for! Rejoice, Rulers, as in just 5️⃣ days [b]Builders of Greece in its Early Access version will hit the Steam store! [/b]

We acknowledge the mixture of excitement and joy behind today's announcement, and we are sure that you must have many, many important questions... Well, you can trust that we will not leave them unanswered! This is why we have collected a set of basic questions that we answer in the form of [b]Early Access Q&A.[/b]

The answer to the first and most important of them can be found in the title of this post, but we think we should repeat it clear and out loud: [b]Builders of Greece Early Access is coming on 27 Feb 2024! [/b] All right, now that we have your curiosity and attention, let's dive into the Q&A! 🤓


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43072654/7135512c3a64c651da05f188fcee8f4ab4270c74.png[/img]


[h2]Early Access Q&A 📜[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]1. Why did you choose to publish on Early Access?[/h3]

Acknowledging the enthusiastic response of players towards Builders of Greece, we want to invite all the interested players to actively contribute to the development of our game, while offering them a substantial glimpse into the rich experience awaiting them in the full version. 

Based on our experience, we firmly believe that providing players with the direct opportunity to play the title remains the optimal approach to gather valuable feedback and deepen our interactions, which would not have been possible without launching the Early Access version of the game. Making a long story short - we want to constantly improve our title, without taking away your ability to play it. We consider it a win-win situation! 
[hr][/hr]
[h3]2. When do you plan to publish the full version of the game?[/h3]

Our target timeframe falls within about 6 to 12 months, although we are committed to exerting maximum effort to release the full version of Builders of Greece as soon as possible. We will do our best to make sure you don't have to wait long!
[hr][/hr]
[h3]3. What are the differences between Early Access and the full version of the game?[/h3]

In its initial stages, the Early Access version will not offer the full range of mechanics and features that will appear in the full version of the game, however with subsequent patches and Early Access development, Builders of Greece will be enriched with additions such as the weather system, new Campaign Mode missions, expansion of player's City to neighbouring islands, Gods/Faith system, new buildings and military units, even more useful tools, extended technology tree and more! Your feedback and suggestions on how to improve Builders of Greece are of utmost importance to us, and we're eagerly awaiting them all!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43072654/66093e35d4e47d77fde2b7c16f8f6a5ef8e6bfe7.gif[/img]


[h3]4. What's the Early Access content?[/h3]

The Early Access version offers the main Campaign Mode and the Sandbox Mode. The first of them will be a narrative scenario that immerses players in the amazing world of Ancient Greece, providing them with an epic adventure full of varied missions, fateful choices, bloody clashes and smart planning, while the latter will allow players to build their own city without any instructions or specific missions. 

Our main goal is to frequently patch and enrich the game with new content, of course in accordance with players' feedback. According to our plans, such patches will be implemented approximately every three to four weeks. Ultimately, the Early Access version will feature all the main systems and mechanics we planned for the full release, but initially they will not be fully developed and will evolve gradually over time.
[hr][/hr]
[h3]5. How much will it cost? Will I be able to play the full game after its release?[/h3]

Yes! Purchasing the Early Access version will give you access to the full version of the game in the future. As a token of appreciation for players who contribute to advancing and refining our game, we assure that the Early Access version will be priced lower than the complete edition. The Early Access price is still to be announced.

[h3]6. How can I help you develop the game?[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Our community has already proven many times how enthusiastic and energetic it is in helping us develop our title. We believe that thanks to the Early Access version, our player base will increase by thousands of people from all over the world, and as a result, we will receive another portion of very important feedback. 

Players can share their feelings about Builders of Greece via Steam Discussions, our very vivid Discord server, and through numerous Social Media channels. Moreover, previous experiences have demonstrated the effectiveness of dedicated Feedback Forms, which our testers enthusiastically complete. Our intention is to continue this practice.


[h2]Only 5 days left![/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Thank you everyone! We hope you are as hyped as we are and that you can't wait for [b]Feb 27[/b]! Be sure to stay up to date and follow our [url=https://twitter.com/home]communication channels[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/hBecggyvyb]Discord Server[/url].

[b]Once again, thank you for your continued support, everyone! Speak to you soon![/b]

It's hard to believe that [b]it's been over 6 months[/b] since our first encounter with Builders of Greece experience. That's when a group of brave testers (that's you!) entered the amazing world of Ancient Greece and began their adventure as the mighty rulers of magnificent, prosperous Polis. [b]Builders of Greece Demo[/b] provided us with a wealth of knowledge and tons of awesome feedback, for which we are very grateful to you all, guys! 🙏😄

However, there is no need to dwell on the past, as today [b]we have particularly exciting news[/b] for you! But before we move on, we believe it's an opportune moment to pause and provide our cherished community with some well-deserved explanations. 


[url=https://discord.gg/hBecggyvyb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43072654/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png[/img][/url]
[hr][/hr]
As you have surely noticed, there was a slight delay compared to our plans presented on the RoadMap 📋 The Prologue version has been delayed for some time now... [b]but for a good reason![/b] If you had the chance to play the Builders of Greece Demo, you know that what we care about the most is quality and providing you with the best possible gaming experience. 

Regrettably, attaining such a high standard of quality requires time, and we extend our heartfelt gratitude for your enthusiasm and understanding. We appreciate your open and supportive approach to this minor delay! Once again, you proved that [b]you are the best community any developer can dream of[/b] 🥰 And we want to repay you for that!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43072654/4252723d50cf000435fbb5ae20dfbdc73b3f06e0.png[/img]


[h2]It's time to get to the point - Builders of Greece: Prologue Playtest sign-ups starts right now![/h2]
[hr][/hr]
With these things behind us, it's time for the good news! But hey... did you mean just the Prologue? What is this "Playtest" thing? 🤔 No worries! The Prologue version is coming really soon, however, we have decided that [b]we want to pre-empt its release with a Prologue Playtest.[/b] 

While we're very happy with Prologue as it is today, we know that there is still room for the improvement. That's why we need your help, everyone! [b]Become our tester[/b], build your own ancient city, and share your valuable feedback on the Prologue Playtest version! 


[h2]Sign me in! ☝️ How do I play the Prologue Playtest?[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Well... it's simple! All you have to do is visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273100/Builders_of_Greece/][b]Builders of Greece Steam Page[/b][/url] and hit the [b]"Request Access"[/b] button (green box above the announcements section). Once you've done that, wait for the information about the Playtest launch (we will try to grant access to as many players as possible).

No worries, the Prologue Playest version is 100% free of charge, and you can play it as much as you like! 😁 Remember, that [b]the "actual" Prologue will follow soon after! [/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43072654/adf79f42f672f6ddd42f802113d5f27d4f102fd8.gif[/img]


[h2]The differences between Demo and Prologue[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
While the Demo version primarily served as an extensive tutorial to explain the fundamental mechanics of the game, the Prologue is on a whole different level, offering [b]more content and depth. [/b]New buildings, cool features, random events, or more management, and decision-making elements are just to begin with! 

Moreover, the Prologue (ang its Playtest) is based on a scenario similar to those you will encounter in the full game 📜 so you will have a taste of what challenges Builders of Greece will present in the future. Of course, this is still just a substitute for the huge adventure that awaits us after the game's release (which will be much more elaborate and complex), but we're sure you get the idea 🤓

[b]We look forward to receiving your initial feedback[/b] and opinions, and we really hope that you will like this version of the game as much as the Demo (with 80% positive reviews 👍). Rest assured that we have done our best to make it so!

Please remember that we are always happy to answer your questions or refer to your awesome ideas on our Social Media channels and Discord server. Be sure to drop by!




[hr][/hr]

notes.title: A little delay... for a good cause!
notes.content:
[h1] 🏛️ Greetings Builders! 🏛️ [/h1]
[hr][/hr]

We don't know about you, but we remember the very first pre-release version of the game with great joy. Builders of Greece [b]Demo met with a warm, enthusiastic reception[/b], and gathered a really wide group of players who wanted to try their hand as an Ancient Ruler 👑 

According to the plan (i.e. our Content RoadMaP), the next stage after releasing the Demo version was to publish... the Prologue. [b]No worries, everyone, it's coming![/b] 😁 In fact, Builders of Greece: Prologue is already at a very advanced stage of development and now is undergoing the last minor fixes, improvements, and tests. However, the process turned out to be a bit more time-consuming and complex than we originally expected. Titles from the [b]city builder genre[/b] are extremely difficult to balance and polish, and even the smallest change of a seemingly insignificant element can have huge effects in the late stages of the game. Not to mention fixing bugs, adding new features, or improving visuals.

[h3]Making a long story short... we are compelled to postpone the release of Builders of Greece: Prologue 🤓[/h3]


[hr][/hr]
[url=https://discord.gg/hBecggyvyb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/2457a52332739537a74a64a1369ff6b89f30a2d4.png[/img][/url]
[h3]...and talk about the Prologue with our community![/h3]


If we cast our mind back a few months, we'll recall a comparable situation that occurred with the Demo version ⏳ Back then, we also had to ask you for a little more patience and postpone the release date of the game. In the end,[b] it turned out to be a good decision[/b], because the testers' surveys showed that you liked the Demo very much! Well, we believe that will be the case with Prologue as well.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43072654/ccb391174a69c0b86d375a745975f51475ca58e9.png[/img]

[h2]Builders of Greece: Prologue is coming really soon[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
All in all, there is no reason to be worried. We still plan to release the Prologue version [b]as soon as possible[/b], and it's a matter of weeks rather than months. We know how impatiently you are waiting for the next chance to visit the world of Ancient Greece once again and bring your next city to life 👍 We are very grateful for your enthusiasm, and we will make sure to not make you wait too long!

As we have repeatedly pointed out in our previous announcements, our primary goal is to [b]provide you with the highest quality and most fun gaming experience possible[/b] 😎 Thanks to the extra time to work on the Prologue, we can further extend, deepen, and improve the gameplay. A ruler's greatest joy is to see his or her city move toward prosperity and glory, and we want you to feel pride and fulfillment as your empire flourishes. That's why our testers, programmers, and designers won't rest until they are sure that [b]the Prologue version looks exactly as we planned.[/b] 

That being said, we want to [b]thank you for your continued support and understanding[/b]! We will soon announce more exciting news related to Builders of Greece: Prologue, and we will be sure to provide more details. Until then - stay hyped, everyone! 😁



[h3]Add Builders of Greece to your Wishlist![/h3]

notes.title: Builders of Greece Demo Launch
notes.content:
[h1] 🏛️ Greetings Builders! 🏛️ [/h1]
[hr][/hr]
Before we get to the point, we want to say a few words about the Playtest. First of all, we are deeply grateful for the [b]huge amount of feedback you provided[/b] - seriously! 🤩 

Your enthusiasm and awesome testing skills overwhelmed us and thanks to you, we were able to introduce lots of fixes, improvements, and quality-of-life changes. We had [b]only a few days[/b] from the launch of the Playtest to the release of the Demo version of the game, but thanks to your amazing cooperation, we managed to make huge progress. [b]Thank you, everyone! [/b]🙏

And now, let's cut to the chase! This is the day we've all been eagerly waiting for! 

[previewyoutube=rgYd73QoCls;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Builders of Greece Demo version is now Live![/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The demo, which is open to all the players around the world, will give you a taste of what awaits you in the full version of the game 🤓 As mentioned, we've been [b]working really hard on improving the Demo[/b] to make it as fun and relaxing experience as possible. You must be wondering... what has changed? No worries, we got you - here is [b]a list of the most important changes[/b] that have been made from the Playtest to the Demo version of Builders of Greece.

• Most importantly, we dealt with the numerous bugs you reported - that was the biggest and the most difficult challenge

• We have made some corrections and updates to the translations

• We have added support for more monitor resolutions

• Overall AI and game balance received a good deal of adjustments and fixes


[h2]But the Demo is just the beginning...[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We are very happy that [b]you are accompanying us on our way[/b] with the Builders of Greece project. The Playtest and Demo versions are huge milestones that bring us closer to our main goal, which is the release of the full version of the game ✊ Seeing your first reactions and comments, we are very optimistic... [b]over 80% of you rated the early version as POSITIVE![/b] For a game developer, there is no better reward and motivation. Once again - thank you all and let's keep on rolling! 😁
